coverage.assessment: Two causal links lost by the revision: 'Moreover' now has no prior benefit, and Rita moves from 'You haven't got it' to bargaining without being persuaded. The plan chain, Albert's call order, and the bottle, glass and revolver setup are intact.
The table appears at 'opposite you' and 'across the table' but is never introduced. Tuppence's entry into the hall is also elided. The washstand and revolver positions are intact.
Cutting Tuppence's soothing line leaves two consecutive Rita paragraphs, the second marked 'reiterated'. 'Not exactly' now answers a question that was cut.
The sum stays £100,000, Rita never names Brown, and Tuppence's knowledge stays limited. Sir James's conditional 'If this boy is alive' is dropped, which hardens his claim; this is folded into F6.
Narration stays close to Tuppence. Rita's terror points over Tuppence's head at both named men, with no hint of which one caused it. Nothing reveals Sir James or the later forgery.
Sir James's 'just by asking her questions' was cut, and so were Tuppence's 'melodramatic' quip and her gunpoint bravado. The famous lines and Julius's slang survive.
The Tommy/Julius contrast in Tuppence's reliance is cut, a tradeoff. The money-creed turn (V5, V6) survives.
All local endpoints are intact. Dependencies 1 and 2 lost their partner endpoints in the revised 026 and 027.

strengths: All eight verbatim passages survive. 'I'm on top and you're underneath' is kept so that 'Now who's on top' pays off.
The doorway ending names both men and gives no cue to which one caused Rita's terror.
Albert's instructions keep the order Julius first, then Sir James, and the revolver stays on the edge of the washstand beside the bottle and glass.
The economy joke about mentioning £100,000 rather than the million, and Tuppence's horror at her kinship with Rita, are preserved intact.
summary: The revision keeps every essential beat, all eight verbatim passages, both suspects' neutrality and the ending in the doorway. No premature revelation occurs. The revision itself, rather than the first draft, introduced several small residues from its trims: a doubled Rita turn marked 'reiterated', a dangling 'Moreover', a table never set up, an unanswered 'Not exactly', and Rita accepting the bribe with no persuasion. It also thinned Sir James's smooth legal voice. Each needs only a few restored words. Two partner endpoints, in 026 and 027, were cut in their own chapters and are not charged to this chapter.
